title: karbobala ke hyder aaqa madad ko aao
body:
karbobala ke hyder aaqa madad ko aao
aye shaah ke baradar aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
toofaa'n me hai safeena aye ashiqe sakina
jaldi bachaalo aakar aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya bhula rahi hai qurbaanie shahe dee'n
aye aashana e sarwar aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
le le ke qushk kooze pyase khade huwe hai
kardo ata samandar aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
ye qoob jaanti hai baazu nahi hai fir bhi
dunya khadi hai dar par aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbat ki laaj rakh lo ulfat ki laaj rakhlo
aye etebaare sarwar aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
shere quda ki dukhtar zainab ka waasta hai
sabro raza ke paikar aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
azmat ki sarhado me kounain ki hadou me
hai koun tumse behtar aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne gharou me bachhe bhooke bilak rahe hai
tum ho ghareeb parwar aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
takra rahe hai hum se zulmo sitam ke lashkar
shere quda ke dilbar aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
aayina e azaae shaahe huda ki janib
aane lage hai pathar aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
chaaha hua adhera hai bewafaio ka
arshe wafa ke aqtar aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
jhutla rahi hai dunya pyasou ki wo kahaani
mashko alam ko lekar aaqa madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
kaskol e dil badhaaye kab se bilal o aamir
aake khade hai dar par aaqa madad ko aao
